SBI Gold Direct Plan Growth SBI Gold Direct Plan Growth is a Commodities Mutual Fund Scheme launched by SBI Mutual Fund. This scheme was made available to investors on 29 Jun 1987. Pradeep Kesavan is the Current Fund Manager of SBI Gold Direct Plan Growth fund. The fund currently has an Asset Under Management(AUM) of ₹11,46,811 Cr and the Latest NAV as of 24 Apr 2026 is ₹45.77. The SBI Gold Direct Plan Growth is rated High risk. Minimum SIP Investment is set to ₹500. Minimum Lumpsum Investment is ₹5,000. Exit load of 1% if redeemed within 15 days. ...Read more Investment Objective The Scheme seeks to provide returns that closely correspond to returns provided by SBI Gold Exchange Traded Scheme (SBI GETS). You can easily invest in SBI Gold Direct Plan Growth in a hassle-free manner on Groww. The process is extremely simple, quick and completely paperless. Invest in a few minutes with the following steps: Log on to your Groww account Search for SBI Gold Direct Plan Growth from the search box In order to invest, you will have to complete all the KYC formalities which are completely online and paperless and take a few minutes to complete Once you are done with that, you can start investing in SBI Gold Direct Plan Growth as SIP or lumpsum as per your investment objective and risk tolerance What kind of returns does SBI Gold Direct Plan Growth provide? The SBI Gold Direct Plan Growth has been there from 01 Jan 2013 and the average annual returns provided by this fund is 54.02% since its inception. How much expense ratio is charged by SBI Gold Direct Plan Growth? The term Expense Ratio used for SBI Gold Direct Plan Growth or any other mutual fund is the annual charges one needs to pay to the Mutual Fund company for managing your investments in that fund. The Expense Ratio of SBI Gold Direct Plan Growth is 0.25% as of 25 Apr 2026... What is the AUM of SBI Gold Direct Plan Growth? The AUM, short for Assets Under Management of SBI Gold Direct Plan Growth is ₹14,997.68Cr as of 25 Apr 2026. How to Redeem SBI Gold Direct Plan Growth? If you want to sell your SBI Gold Direct Plan Growth holdings, go to your holding on the app or web and simply click on it. You will get two options - redeem & invest more; click on redeem and enter your desired amount or if you wish to redeem the entire holding amount then select the 'redeem all' checkbox. Can I invest in SIP and Lump Sum of SBI Gold Direct Plan Growth? You can select either SIP or Lumpsum investment of SBI Gold Direct Plan Growth based on your investment objective and risk tolerance. What is the NAV of SBI Gold Direct Plan Growth? The NAV of SBI Gold Direct Plan Growth is ₹45.77 as of 24 Apr 2026. What is the PE and PB ratio of SBI Gold Direct Plan Growth? The PE ratio ratio of SBI Gold Direct Plan Growth is determined by dividing the market price by its earnings per share and the PB ratio of the same is evaluated by dividing the stock price per share by its book value per share (BVPS).
